# Site for sale

> 1.2 Acre site for sale located less than 3km from Knock village and all its amenities. The site comes to the market with unrestricted full planning permission for a detached bungalow style residence. The site is elevated in nature and has fabulous views of the surrounding hinterland.

- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Plocha: 4856 m²
- Energetická náročnost: Exempt
- Lokalita: Shanvaghera, Knock
